title: Maths-to-hardware graduate routes
scope: Singapore and Hong Kong first; selected international conversion routes
ranking_basis: Admissibility evidence, technical fit and work-integrated training, not estimated job probabilities

programmes.name: NUS MSc Semiconductor Technology and Operations
programmes.admission_evidence: STEM bachelor explicitly includes Mathematics; at least NUS second-class honours or equivalent. Discretionary intake may consider relevant working experience; competitive selection.
programmes.tuition: AY2027/28 S$59,600 including GST; miscellaneous fees/living costs extra; acceptance payment credited, not extra.
programmes.industry_evidence: Optional 8-unit, 15-week Singapore industry internship for full-time students. Packaging/testing and IC technology courses.
programmes.caution: Best local fabrication-facing match, but not every internship is fab engineering; projects may concern business/operations. No verified programme-specific placement rate.

programmes.name: NUS MSc Computer Engineering — Computing Hardware Infrastructure
programmes.admission_evidence: Admission explicitly includes applied mathematics; honours preferred. General/pure mathematics is not explicitly named; a pure-maths transcript needs individual eligibility assessment, not an assumption that it counts as applied mathematics.
programmes.tuition: AY2027/28 S$59,600 including GST; miscellaneous fees/living costs extra.
programmes.industry_evidence: Hardware acceleration/reconfigurable computing, FPGA, embedded systems, VLSI digital design elective; specialisation requires project.
programmes.caution: Best explicit applied-maths route toward accelerator/FPGA work; not wafer fabrication and not a guaranteed GPU/TPU design job. No internship requirement found.

programmes.name: Boston University LEAP → MS Electrical & Computer Engineering
programmes.admission_evidence: LEAP accepts non-engineering backgrounds. Calculus I grade B or better within five years before matriculation; GRE listed in current FAQ. Personalised undergraduate engineering foundation before masters.
programmes.next_intake_deadline: Fall 2027 priority January 15, final March 15; Spring 2027 November 1, 2026 deadline is imminent, not a reason to rush an incomplete application.
programmes.tuition: 2026/27 masters US$2,282/credit; 32-credit ECE MS US$73,024 tuition alone. LEAP foundation costs additional and not published as one fixed total.
programmes.industry_evidence: Engineering Practice masters option incorporates paid internship; obtaining a position is not guaranteed.
programmes.caution: Real conversion rather than pretending a maths degree includes circuits. Typically at least two years full-time. Expensive; nationality, visa and internship authorisation must be assessed separately.

programmes.name: Purdue online MS — Microelectronics and Semiconductors
programmes.admission_evidence: Nonengineering applicants including mathematics can receive MS (not MSE). Detailed admissions minimum GPA 3.2; strong candidates 3.4. Calculus I/II plus linear algebra or differential equations for credit.
programmes.next_intake_deadline: Annual deadlines: spring December 1, summer May 1, fall August 1.
programmes.tuition: Published US$1,459/credit nonresident; 30 credits implies US$43,770 before other charges or future increases; Indiana/VA-benefit rate differs.
programmes.industry_evidence: Online curriculum spanning packaging, devices, circuits and systems. No guaranteed hands-on fab internship documented.
programmes.caution: Skills route, not a US relocation or campus-recruiting substitute. Overview says GPA 3.0 while detailed admissions says 3.2: use stricter detailed criterion pending clarification.

programmes.name: CityU MSc Intelligent Semiconductor Manufacturing
programmes.admission_evidence: Engineering/science degree or equivalent; maths is not individually named. Eligibility needs transcript-specific assessment.
programmes.tuition: Not verified: official fee page returned 403.
programmes.industry_evidence: Manufacturing-focused degree; no audited placement rate or guaranteed internship verified.
programmes.caution: Strong topical match but do not label confirmed maths-admissible. Full-time one year; 30 credits.

programmes.name: CityU MSc Electrical and Electronic Engineering
programmes.admission_evidence: Published entry rule requires recognised degree/equivalent without a named discipline restriction; not evidence of remedial circuits teaching.
programmes.industry_evidence: Applied Research Internship Scheme; 30-credit route one year, 45-credit industrial-research option 1.5 years full-time.
programmes.caution: More credible work-integrated structure than generic employer logos. Technical readiness and internship selection remain risks.

programmes.name: NTU MSc Integrated Circuits & Microelectronics
programmes.admission_evidence: Good relevant bachelor degree. Mathematics not explicitly named. Renamed from MSc Electronics from August 2026.
programmes.next_intake_deadline: Next exact application deadline not verified.
programmes.industry_evidence: Includes digital/analog IC, VLSI, wafer processing, packaging and Graduate Professional Internship course.
programmes.caution: Attractive technical breadth; not safe to assume a maths-only transcript is relevant enough.

programmes.name: TUM Asia/NTU MSc Integrated Circuit Design
programmes.admission_evidence: Electrical/electronics engineering or closely related bachelor; mathematics not explicitly accepted.
programmes.next_intake_deadline: Exact ICD deadline not verified; do not copy another TUM programme deadline.
programmes.tuition: Published total S$58,403.07 including 9% GST; registration payment included.
programmes.industry_evidence: Industry-oriented programme; internship/thesis structure requires programme-specific final check.
programmes.caution: Do not prioritise for maths-only applicant without substantial circuits and electronics coursework.

programmes.name: HKUST MSc Integrated Circuits
programmes.admission_evidence: Second-class honours in Electronic Engineering, Engineering Science or Physical Sciences. Mathematics cannot automatically be treated as Physical Sciences.
programmes.industry_evidence: System definition through tapeout curriculum; no verified programme-specific placement rate.
programmes.caution: Conditional stretch, not confirmed conversion. One year full-time.

programmes.name: HKU MSc(Eng) Integrated Circuits & Electronic Systems
programmes.admission_evidence: Programme wording: Engineering or related Science. Generic faculty wording mentioning mathematics is not programme-specific assurance.
programmes.next_intake_deadline: 2027/28 main January 4, 2027 noon HKT; clearing April 9 noon HKT.
programmes.industry_evidence: 72-credit curriculum including dissertation focused on integrated circuits and electronic systems. No reliable placement statistics verified.
programmes.caution: Engineering/related-science wording does not explicitly establish maths eligibility; generic faculty admissions wording is insufficient.

programmes.name: HKU MSc(Eng) Microelectronics Science & Technology
programmes.admission_evidence: Programme wording: Engineering or related Science. Generic faculty wording mentioning mathematics is not programme-specific assurance.
programmes.next_intake_deadline: 2027/28 main January 4, 2027 noon HKT; clearing April 9 noon HKT.
programmes.industry_evidence: 72-credit curriculum including dissertation; describes cleanroom/fabrication work. No reliable placement statistics verified.
programmes.caution: MST recruitment page contains unrelated construction/accreditation/testimonial template text. Do not use employer logos/testimonials as evidence.

programmes.name: CUHK MSc Electronic Engineering
programmes.admission_evidence: EE/information/computer engineering normally; other disciplines considered with electronics experience/background. Mathematics not named.
programmes.industry_evidence: No verified guaranteed internship or programme-specific placement rate.
programmes.caution: Not a direct route for a maths-only fresh graduate.

placement_data: No audited programme-specific employment rate established in this research pass. Industry links and internships are not job guarantees.
